snippet.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official Who Do You Think You Are YouTube channel.

The Bafta award-winning BBC show, that takes viewers on personal journeys into the pasts of popular celebrities. The long-running series uses genealogy to unlock the major themes in history including the Industrial Revolution, Immigration, the First and Second World Wars, the abolition of slavery and the Holocaust. 

In each episode we reveal the real person behind the celebrity, as they come to understand who they truly are, the lives their ancestors lived, and their identity. Each episode reveals the surprising, extraordinary and often moving stories of our ancestors, which is likely to inspire others to trace their family trees.

Subscribe & enable notifications for all the latest highlights 👉 http://bit.ly/WDYTYAyt
Check out our podcast 👉 http://bit.ly/WhoDoPodcast

snippet.title: Explore Documentary Films
snippet.description:
explore™ is a multimedia organization that champions the selfless acts of others, documenting leaders around the world who have devoted their lives to extraordinary causes.  

Both educational and inspirational, explore films cover topics from animal rights, health and human services, and poverty to the environment, education, and spirituality. 

explore (http://explore.org) is also an online community where people share, dialogue, and experience films and photography to bring cultural context to philanthropy.

snippet.title: Dark History
snippet.description:
Welcome to Dark History – where the shadows of the past come alive. 🕯️

Here, we uncover the untold, chilling, and mysterious stories that shaped our world. From vanished armies and haunted castles, to unsolved mysteries, forbidden legends, and the blood-soaked secrets of empires—this channel takes you deep into the forgotten corners of history.

Each documentary is crafted to feel like a cinematic journey into the past, blending storytelling, research, and atmosphere to bring you face-to-face with the darkest events humanity has ever known.

If you’re fascinated by:
⚔️ Lost civilizations
👻 Ghostly legends & haunted places
📜 Forgotten battles & conspiracies
🔮 Ancient mysteries and secrets…

Then Dark History is your home.

👉 Subscribe now and step into the shadows—because history was never as innocent as it seemed.
